title: OpenRouter Drops AI Providers Following Months of Prompt Theft
excerpt: OpenRouter dropped three AI inference providers after researchers discovered months of covert prompt data theft affecting requests.
body_html:
OpenRouter has removed three AI inference providers following a discovery by industrial cybersecurity company Dragos. Researchers found that attackers secretly stole data from inside the three AI hosting firms for months without their knowledge.

According to the findings, some of the compromised requests were marked with the Zero Data Retention setting, which is intended to ensure that user prompts are never stored.
